alt: Salt and Ink on a reading table, its cover an old map of a harbour with a compass rose, beside a dip pen and a bottle of ink.
prompt:
Image 1 is a style reference only: copy its medium, painterly brushwork, palette, lamplight and level of detail. Do not copy its subject or composition.
Use: card picture for one book in a bookshop's 'New this week' list, shown at about 360 by 203 pixels (cropped to 16:9 from the centre).
Subject: a paperback essay collection called Salt and Ink: its cover art shows an old hand-drawn harbour map with a compass rose; next to it a dip pen and a small ink bottle, lying on a wooden reading table by the shop window in the evening.
Composition: top-down three-quarter view, the book fills about 55% of the width and sits in the centre third, nothing important near the top or bottom edges.
Style: warm editorial illustration, flat shapes with soft painted edges, no outlines; palette of deep harbour blue, lamp amber, paper cream and brick red; evening lamplight from the left; calm and uncluttered.
Constraints: the cover has no title lettering and no text at all, no letters or numbers anywhere, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border, no people.
